_comment_1: PATCH SNIPPET -- merge these keys into Jarvis's existing config.json, do not replace the whole file. Unlisted keys (db_path, active_profiles, tts_*, wake_word, whisper_model) stay as they are.
_comment_2: ollama_base_url now points at the proxy (port 11435). The proxy forwards embeddings to your REAL Ollama on 11434, so keep Ollama running with `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`.
_comment_2a: DEFAULT SWITCHED TO GROQ (FREE) 2026-07-06. GLM-5.2 is not free -- $1.40/$4.40 per M tokens, or $18/mo minimum flat plan. Groq's free tier (no credit card) hosts openai/gpt-oss-120b, an open model with real tool-calling support, on fast hardware. The proxy is provider-agnostic -- point it at Groq instead of Z.ai by setting env vars when you launch it: GLM_API_BASE=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, GLM_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-120b, GLM_API_KEY=<your groq key from console.groq.com>. No code changes needed. If you later want GLM-5.2's extra quality, just change these three env vars back to Z.ai's values and these three model fields to glm-5.2 -- nothing else changes.
_comment_2b: Jarvis uses THREE separate model settings, not one. intent_judge_model and tool_router_model default to a small local model (gemma4:e2b) even after you change ollama_chat_model. The proxy forwards whatever model name Jarvis sends verbatim to the upstream API -- it does NOT override it -- so all three must match whatever model name your chosen provider expects.
_comment_3: Jarvis will show a dismissible 'unsupported model' warning -- that is expected, it is a soft allowlist, not a block.
_comment_4: EDIT THE PATHS BELOW: replace C:/REPLACE/WITH/REAL/PATH/jarvis-setup with wherever you put these scripts. Forward slashes are fine on Windows. Confirmed against isair/jarvis source (settings_window.py): the top-level key is 'mcps', not 'mcp_servers'.
